function: Excluded (system): ISAC-GNN learns UE power, RRU sensing activation and user association, but links are single-antenna with scalar gains g_kn and no RIS (p. 3).
notes: Reason system: single-antenna links, no RIS, in an area 5 work. p. 3: "denotes the channel gain between the" n-th UE and k-th RRU (Eqs. 1-2 use one scalar gain per UE-RRU pair); p. 12: "All channels follow an uncorrelated Rayleigh distribution". The body never mentions antennas, arrays, beamforming or RIS (only the references do), so single-antenna is inferred from the scalar model and is not stated by the authors. The two-channel RRU receiver (reference and monitoring channels, p. 3) is a passive-sensing architecture, not a multi-antenna communication link. Earlier checks pass: the learned ISAC-GNN (pp. 10-11) outputs UE power, RRU sensing activation and user association; power allocation is a physical-layer decision, so above_phy does not apply, and the resources serve sensing and communication, so function does not apply. If the reviewer judges the links to be multi-antenna, the work belongs to area 5. PDF is arXiv 2610.19612v1; its title and authors match the Crossref record of this DOI (checked outside the PDF).
